subject: give error when put input$variable in query using RODBC

messages.author: a3db79518ad18491
messages.subject: give error when put input$variable in query using RODBC
parts:
Hi there,

I am able to write a query within shiny without any problem(use RODBC). But if i put input$variable in the query(My goal is every time the user select a variable from the drop-down list, it will fetch the database and give the corresponding variable values), it will give me error. 

            Error in UseMethod("xtable") : 
            no applicable method for 'xtable' applied to an object of class "character"

Did anyone succeed in doing this? Any suggestions would be appreciated:)  My codes are as followings

ui.r
library(shiny)

shinyUI(pageWithSidebar(

  headerPanel("Sales Amount"),

  sidebarPanel(
selectInput("variable","Variable:",
list("CalendarYear"="CalendarYear","CalendarQuarter"="CalendarQuarter"))
  ),

  mainPanel(
h3(textOutput("caption")),
tableOutput("tableview")
  )
))

server.r
library(shiny)
library(ggplot2)
library(RODBC)


shinyServer(function(input,output){
 
  formulaText <- reactive({
 paste("SalesAmount ~",input$variable)
  })

  output$caption <- renderText({
 formulaText()
  })



  output$tableview <- renderTable({
 channel <- odbcConnect("MS_SQL", uid="", pwd="")
 Salesdata <- sqlQuery(channel,"SELECT 
        [SalesAmountQuota]
        ,input$variable
        FROM [AdventureWorksDW2012].[dbo].[FactSalesQuota]")
 close(channel)
head(Salesdata,n=10)
  })
})

messages.author: 55771919c42cb6a1
messages.subject: Re: give error when put input$variable in query using RODBC
parts:
It looks like the renderTable() is getting a character vector for the return value. In other words, this is a character vector:
  head(Salesdata,n=10)

You can debug this by putting in a print statement just before the last line, like this:
  print(head(Salesdata,n=10))

Or you can insert a browser() there to use the R debugger.

-Winston
